description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training time and loss for two different models, Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis represents training time in seconds, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250,000, and tick labels at intervals of 50,000. The y-axis represents loss, with a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, and tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The plot shows two lines: a purple line with triangle markers representing the Vanilla model, and a red line with circle markers representing the SepLLM model, both with solid line styles. The purple line starts at approximately 2.73 on the y-axis at 0 seconds on the x-axis and decreases to around 2.48 at 250,000 seconds. The red line starts at approximately 2.72 on the y-axis at 0 seconds on the x-axis and decreases to around 2.47 at 250,000 seconds, consistently remaining below the purple line throughout the training time, with both lines showing a steady decline across the x-axis.
